name: Elvenar
author: Addicting Games
description: The world is in chaos! Emeralds, gems, diamonds, and other crystals of power have been scattered across the hostile lands of Elvenar! You will need to rally your tribe, stick together and build a bustling city if you wish to survive the horror of invading tribes, natural phenomena, and the always present concept of entropy. First you will choose your preferred race: Human or Elfen. From there you will have to explore the map of this massively multiplayer online role-playing game in order to find a place to settle and begin building your empire. Stay one step ahead of your competitors and always prepare for the worst. You'll have to manage your resources keenly if you want to survive.
